_about: The karigar units and who is in them. A unit is the thing that EARNS and gets PAID; a person is a member of one. The source is emphatic that a group is never split — 'Karigar name may be a group (e.g. Rabiyul & Ekabat, Rizwan & Tahid) — keep as a single unit, never split' — so the unit is the ledger key and the members are recorded beside it, not instead of it.
_why_this_file_exists: Until now the units were discovered from whatever workbook was uploaded and existed nowhere else. That meant the roster of teams was whatever last month's file happened to contain, and a team that stopped working simply vanished rather than being recorded as ended. Units are data now, dated like everything else.
_membership_is_dated_because_teams_chang: Rabiyul and Ekabat worked as ONE unit through FY2025-26 and as TWO from FY2026-27. That is not a contradiction in the source and not an error in the earlier data — it is a date. FY2025-26 earnings stay pooled under the joint unit and FY2026-27 splits, and nothing about the closed year is rewritten. Any team can merge or split the same way.
_spelling: Ekabot and Ekabat are the same person. The source uses Ekabat, the owner uses Ekabot; both resolve through the alias list rather than by anyone choosing a winner.

units.label: Rabiyul & Team
units._members_note: The owner gave this team as 'Rabiyul + 3'. Three members are counted and unnamed; the count is what he stated and the names are not invented here.

units.label: Rabiyul & Ekabat
units._why_closed: One unit for FY2025-26, then two from FY2026-27. Closed rather than deleted, because every rupee earned in FY2025-26 was earned by this unit and a report for that year must still find it.

units.label: Mustakim
units._date_precision: The owner said 'left in May 2026'. A month, not a day, so the unit closes on the last day of that month and the imprecision is recorded rather than hidden.

units.label: Shubhankar
units._date_precision: Month precision, as above — 'left in Aug 2026'.
units._religion: The only non-Muslim karigar in the source, which matters for exactly one thing: the festival-leave rule. It is recorded for that and used for nothing else.

_counting: Active members total 13 across 5 active units — Sajid & Team 2, Rabiyul & Team 3, Ekabot & Team 2, Sohrab & Team 3, Rizwan & Team 3. It was 14, with Rabiyul & Team at 4, taken from a count the owner gave earlier; his roster of 1 Sep 2026 says "Rabiyul + 2". The newer statement wins and the count follows it rather than the other way round. The two closed single-person units and the closed joint unit are not in this count.
_no_rates_here: Deliberately. What a karigar unit earns comes from the pieces it stitched times the rate in the rates master, per piece and never per set. A rate typed into this file would be a second source of truth for money.
